criterionAnalysis: 4.1.2 needs a name and role that software can read. The probes show role button and name Choose Files on both states, supplied by the browser's file input. The input is an invisible overlay that sits next to a visible, named Upload attachment button on invoicing and behind the named Upload bill popover on Bill Pay, so no user depends on its name. 3.3.2 and 2.4.6 are met by the visible labels of those controls. No other A or AA criterion fails.
reason: Both verifiers' ax probes read the overlay input as button Choose Files, so it has a programmatic name and role; it is out of the tab order (tabindex -1) and ignores the pointer, and the controls people use to open the same picker, Upload bill and Upload attachment, are named. AE3 covers a button with no name; this one has one, so no A or AA criterion fails.
